scope: Retrieval budget selection, distinct terms, selection fingerprint v2, early session-reference validation

failureHistory.result: New budget regression failed on the prior release executable: one record returned instead of four fitting records. Existing 19 context checks passed.
failureHistory.resolution: Rank lightweight descriptors and pack whole fitting records; continue after non-fitting candidates.

failureHistory.result: An added Unicode fixture incorrectly expected the escaped record plus all other notes to fit an 8192-byte packet. Native checks and the preceding budget assertions passed; the script stopped at that fixture assertion.
failureHistory.resolution: Query the escaped record specifically for its round-trip assertion; retain independent budget/coverage/counter assertions across seven budgets. Final complete verification passed.

compatibility.legacyFingerprintRefresh: One acknowledged update on the existing thread; then unchanged selections avoid further injection.
compatibility.corruptReferences: Rejected and retained, including when new-thread mode is requested.

limitations: No new native Codex or real-model verification; lifecycle operations use in-process fixtures.
Conditional injection behavior does not measure actual model token or billing savings.
Greedy record packing can reserve a few bytes for metadata and does not promise optimal utilization.
Whole-store integrity checking and conflict grouping remain proportional to stored data.
Natural real-model compaction recovery, comparative benefit and total agent/tool resource cost remain unverified.
Hosted CI, Linux execution and online dependency advisory scanning remain unverified.
Plaintext storage, heuristic secret detection and cooperative filesystem checks retain their documented limits.
